transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to address the Northstar Systems royalty reporting discrepancies. As you know, our license agreement permits a royalty audit when reporting discrepancies are identified, and Northstar's quarterly reports have been showing inconsistent usage figures. The commercial team wants this handled without disrupting the existing license. Before I can approve any enforcement plan, I need to hear recommendations from each of our specialists -- finance, IP, privacy, and account counsel. Once all four recommendations are on the table, I'll record them in the enforcement checklist and make the final call. Let's get started. Who would like to go first?
